headline: Worried that extending a mortgage to 40 years will affect credit records? Several bank staff: the extension itself has no impact, only overdue payments affect credit records
summary: Several bank staff say extending a mortgage to 40 years has no direct impact on credit records, and only overdue payments affect them.
why: Mortgage terms and borrower credit records shape household debt levels and the health of bank loan books.

original_headline: 担心房贷展期至40年影响征信？多家银行人士：展期本身无影响，出现逾期才影响征信
